solution: The server provides one controlled update service for all clients. It can apply the same validation/access rules before accepting each request, reducing inconsistent or unauthorized updates to the shared records. A client can request a change without receiving unrestricted database credentials.

marking_points.criterion: Explains consistent validation/access for client requests.
